description:
To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `ErrorsOAuth2.json`, a single error item, expressed as a JSON object, conform to RFC 7807.
The general error description is extended with OAuth2 specific error details.

status.description: HTTP status code as string, defined by JSON API

error.description: In OAuth2 RFC (clause 5.2) specified error types

error_description.description: Readable OAuth2 error description, embedded in the error response, type string.

error_uri.description: Absolute URL reference to to a detailed description of the OAuth2 error, type uri.
